```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false # keeps rendered Quarto less noisy

library(tidyverse)
library(mosaic)
library(skimr)
library(ggformula)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)

C <- read_csv("data/panel-C.csv")
```


```{r}
skim(C)
inspect(C)
glimpse(C)
```
```{r}
Cmod <- C |> dplyr::mutate(country=as.factor(country), continent=as.factor(continent))
glimpse(Cmod)

```


```{r}
# QUESTION 1: does higher GDP mean more Life expectancy

ggplot(Cmod, aes(x = gdpPercap, y = lifeExp)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = continent), size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = country), size = 2.5, vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "GDP per Capita vs Life Expectancy",
    x = "GDP per Capita (log scale)",
    y = "Life Expectancy",
    color = "Continent"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


ggplot(Cmod, aes(x = gdpPercap, y = lifeExp)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = continent), size = 3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = country), size = 2.5, vjust = -0.5) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "GDP per Capita vs Life Expectancy",
    x = "GDP per Capita (log scale)",
    y = "Life Expectancy",
    color = "Continent"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


Cmod |>
  gf_point(lifeExp ~ gdpPercap, color = ~ continent) |>
  gf_labs(
    x = "GDP per Capita (log scale)",
    y = "Life Expectancy",
    title = "GDP per Capita vs Life Expectancy"
  ) +
  scale_x_log10()


```

```{r}
#QUESTION 2: 
Cmod |> gf_bar(continent ~ pop, fill = ~ continent)
##Cmod |> gf_bar(country ~ pop, fill = ~ continent, bins = 100)

```

```{r}
world <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
#glimpse(world)
```


```{r}
#world |> gf_sf(geometry = ~geometry)
```

```{r}
worldSelect <- world |> dplyr::select(name, geometry)
Cmod <- C |> left_join(worldSelect, by = c("country" = "name"))
Cmodded <- Cmod |> dplyr::mutate(country=as.factor(country), continent=as.factor(continent))

#glimpse(Cmodded)
```

```{r}
Cmodded |> gf_sf(geometry = ~geometry, fill = ~ lifeExp, color = ~continent)
#of all the countires I have life expectency is the worst in the african countires and afganistan
Cmodded |> gf_sf(geometry = ~geometry, fill = ~ pop, color = ~continent)
#highest population countires are china and india
Cmodded |> gf_sf(geometry = ~geometry, fill = ~ gdpPercap, color = ~continent)
#highest gdp is in north american countires europe and australia

```
